records.description: Create realistic phone, tablet, and desktop wallpaper mockups in bulk. Upload wallpapers locally, customize lock screen details, preview instantly, and export PNG or ZIP files.

records.name: lektrix PDF
records.tagline: fast. private. powerful.
records.description: Merge, split, compress, convert, and sign PDFs — fully offline. No uploads. No tracking. Lightning fast.

records.name: aicovea
records.tagline: Generate AI images, videos, prompts & edits
records.description: AIcovea is a creative AI workspace for generating images, videos, prompts, and edits in one place. It brings model-specific tools, prompt examples, and creative workflows together so creators, marketers, and indie makers can test ideas faster without jumping between separate AI sites.

records.name: ToneTraffic
records.tagline: AI-powered sentiment analysis for social media comments
records.description: ToneTraffic is a Chrome extension that uses AI to instantly analyze the sentiment of comments on social media platforms. It color-codes comments as positive, negative, neutral, or sarcastic, helping you quickly understand the emotional tone of any conversation. Perfect for content creators, marketers, and community managers who want to gauge audience reactions at a glance without reading every single comment.

records.name: The Buffett Screen
records.tagline: Screen any stock through Warren Buffett's eyes
records.description: The Buffett Screen is an AI-powered stock screener that evaluates any publicly traded stock against Warren Buffett's 10 core value investing criteria — including moat, ROE, debt, free cash flow, and margin of safety. Enter a ticker. Get a BUY, WATCH, or NO BUY verdict, a Buffett conviction score out of 100, and a plain-English analysis written in Buffett's own voice. Reach Takarudana Mapendembe by email, or connect on LinkedIn, X, Facebook, and Medium.

records.name: Disorganized Notes: Open source release!
records.tagline: notes, todo, open-source, productivity
records.description: The note taking app for busy people, now open source!

records.name: Vivago Video Agent
records.tagline: Skip the prompting. Produce consistently compelling videos.
records.description: Vivago Video Agent lets you generate consistently compelling narrative videos with natural language. No more annoying prompting! Our video agent ensures every scene stays on-brand and internally coherent by guiding you through a structured creative process. Just share your assets and describe your story — a swarm of AI directors will invent characters and write a compelling story for you. See the keyframes before rendering. Your 1-min 1080P story video will be ready in 40 mins.

records.name: AiFinPay
records.tagline: Stripe for AI agents with real on-chain payments
records.description: AiFinPay is payment infrastructure for autonomous AI agents. One SDK call enables agents to pay AI services instantly with real on-chain settlement. Live on Polygon mainnet with x402 support, bridge modes, MCP integrations, multichain payments (Polygon + Solana), and support for USDC, USDT, MATIC and SOL. Built for agent-to-agent commerce and AI-native economies.

records.name: Fere AI
records.tagline: AI agents that turn signals into crypto + Polymarket trades
records.description: Unlike generic crypto research assistants, Fere turns market signals into autonomous trading workflows. Agents research opportunities, build trade setups, optimize routes and fees, execute with a wallet, and monitor strategies 24/7 across crypto and Polymarket. Standout features include autonomous Polymarket trading, entry/exit rules, stop-loss controls, execution routing, and lower-cost agent runs.

records.name: Industrial Rubber Rollers
records.tagline: Rubber Roller Exporter to South Africa | Anar Rub Tech
records.description: Anar Rub Tech is a trusted manufacturer and exporter of industrial rubber rollers for South Africa’s printing, packaging, textile, paper, and converting industries. We supply flexographic printing rollers, rotogravure rollers, silicone rubber rollers, coating rollers, and customized industrial rollers engineered for durability, precision, and reliable performance. Serving Johannesburg, Cape Town, Durban, and global industrial markets with quality export solutions.

records.name: Coriven Proof
records.tagline: Find the 15-30% AI waste hiding in your org's spend
records.description: Enterprise AI governance and observability platform. Connects to your SSO, CASB, and expense systems to discover every AI tool in use — sanctioned or not. Runs 18 patent-pending waste detection rules to find hidden spend with dollar recovery estimates. Maps OWASP Top 10 for LLM compliance gaps. Tracks developer productivity by task type and model cost. Every data point confidence-tagged as Verified, Calculated, or Estimated. No black box. Built for the CISO, CFO, and CTO who need proof.

records.name: InvPrp
records.tagline: AI interview prep tailored to your target job
records.description: InvPrp is an AI-powered interview preparation platform that turns your resume and target job description into a personalised study roadmap. Unlike generic question banks, it analyses your profile against real job requirements to generate structured learning paths with mock tests, audio practice interviews, and AI feedback. Features include resume ATS analysis, LinkedIn profile optimisation, salary benchmarking, and self-introduction coaching — all designed to help you land your next role faster.
